text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, so this is the shrine that wards off evil, huh?
Hmmmmm...

I had come to a shrine famous for warding off evil with her.
The reason being――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, Trainer?
I might be cursed...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, you see—

According to her, she's been feeling out of sorts lately
ever since she watched a trending cursed video online
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm not scared at all!
In the first place, why would I get cursed, anyway?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still, just in case, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

And so, to help her regain her form,
we visited a shrine known for warding off misfortune.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, if I make my wish here...!
Hnnngh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Please, please, pleeease...!

Tokai Teio pressed her hands together with all her might
and said a prayer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that should do it! After all, I pleaded with
every ounce of my being!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The curse has definitely been broken!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I mean, whatever?
It's not like I'm scared of curses or anything, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's head home, Trainer!
Just as Tokai Teio began walking to leave the shrine grounds—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! Whoa-whoa-whoa!!!
"I stepped on some fallen leavesand slipped—...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, whoa... hup!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Did you see that just now!?
Isn't it amazing that I didn't fall!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I suddenly felt so light on my feet!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! Could it be the curse is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: N-Not that I care at all, though!?
Though she was trying to play it off as usual, there was a look of relief in her smile.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Whoa, whoaaaa—!?
"I stepped on some fallen leavesand slipped—...!!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow ow...
I took a spectacular spill...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I can't believe I tripped over something like that...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!
Could it be the curse is still...active?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer.
Why don't we buy a charm from over there before we go?

Afterward, Tokai Teio bought three amulets
to ward off evil before heading home.
